name: Argoverse 2 — Sensor Dataset
description: Next-generation multimodal autonomous driving dataset from Argo AI and Carnegie Mellon University, comprising 1,000 raw 15-second driving sequences collected across six major U.S. cities (Austin, Detroit, Miami, Palo Alto, Pittsburgh, and Washington, D.C.). Features 7 ring cameras, 2 front-facing stereo cameras, 2 roof-mounted 32-beam LiDARs spinning in opposite directions, and rich HD vector map coverage. Includes 3D oriented cuboids for 26 distinct object categories with high-precision egovehicle poses.
